historical_references.reference: The Yadavs, also known as Anjana-Vansh, Yanivansh or Yadava-Kshatriyas, are a major community in the Indian subcontinent, particularly in North India.
historical_references.context: The Yadavs are believed to be the descendants of Lord Krishna, and the name Yanivansh refers to this lineage.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Yanivansh can be found in the epics Mahabharata and Ramayana. The Mahabharata mentions Yadu, a descendant of Lord Krishna, as the ancestor of the Yadav clan.
historical_references.context: The name Yanivansh is derived from Yadu, and signifies the dynastic lineage of Lord Krishna and the Yadav community.
